memory.meaning: initial workload sizing target, not a minimum occupancy requirement
memory.measure: complete forward, backward, optimizer step; include process and allocator peaks

batch.selection: bounded increasing candidates, fresh process per probe; choose a measured safe candidate
batch.formal_training: Fixed effective batch and optimization protocol; device-specific microbatch must account for BN behavior

priority.background: finite protocol-locked UKB native training and MHD validation tasks
priority.handoff: finish bounded case or verified checkpoint, terminate worker to release CUDA memory before foreground
priority.resume: only unfinished cases; accepted cases never loop to retain allocation
